title: Clip-level aggregation + LOCO clip calibration
why: Goal (a): decide at the clip level from window scores; which aggregator separates the 7 clip verdicts and how much window review is needed for a target clip error
hypothesis: A high-quantile or rank aggregate beats the mean because a clip is bad when a tail of its windows is bad
data: IndEgo human gold 150 windows/7 clips (labels/manifest_gold.json) + cached oof_probs.npz
method: mean/median/q75/q90/trimmed/rank-mean of 1-p_ens; clip truth bad_frac>=0.30; LOCO threshold + isotonic; clip AUROC; uncertainty-targeted review curve

title: Sequential SPRT clip decision frontier
why: Goal (a): process windows one at a time and stop when evidence crosses accept/reject/abstain bounds; sweep bounds to get clip error vs windows processed vs abstain
hypothesis: A Wald SPRT on calibrated log-odds reaches the tolerated clip-verdict accuracy with fewer reviewed windows than a fixed grid
data: IndEgo gold + cached oof_probs.npz; OOD-60 never used for fitting
method: soft Bernoulli SPRT on 1-p; hard (binary at 0.5), soft (p_platt) and label-oracle modes; (A,B) sweep; error/cost/abstain frontier

title: Best sequential cell + next-100 active labels
why: Goal (a)+(b): pick cheapest tolerated policy and rank the 1,546 unlabelled Egocentric-10K windows by expected information for OOD error
hypothesis: Diversified uncertainty sampling surfaces the most valuable next labels
data: artifacts/windows_rescored.jsonl (1,546 unlabelled); OOD-60 labels for EVALUATION ONLY
method: tolerance-based best-cell selection; greedy 4p(1-p)+view-gap with factory/clip redundancy penalty; OOD-60 eval

summary: q75 aggregator best clip AUROC 0.917 (mean 0.833); LOCO clip BA <=0.75 (5/7) for every aggregator -> clip verdicts are discriminative but thin. Uncertainty-targeted review: 35% of windows -> error<=1/7, 65% -> 7/7 (vs every-2 51.5% -> 7/7).
decision: No single aggregator lifts clip BA above 5/7; use q75/mean only as a ranking signal, not a certified verdict.
cost: CPU-only on cached labels+scores, no GPU

summary: Best tolerated SPRT cell (A=4.9,B=3.7, hard) decides 5/5 correct with 2/7 abstained but at 66.5% of windows -- MORE than every-2's 51.5%. Label-oracle SPRT also 65.5% at 7/7. Soft expected-LLR never accepts (clip-level miscalibration). Sequential early stop does NOT drop review at equal error.
decision: Keep fixed every-2 grid; use SPRT only as a clip-level abstain gate. Negative result kept.

summary: Best tolerated cell = A=4.9,B=3.7 hard (5/5 correct, 2/7 abstain, 66.5% windows). Next-100 active labels written (47/47 factories). OOD-60 eval: uncertainty U AUROC 0.349 (anti-correlated) -> uncertainty sampling does not find confidently-wrong domain-shift errors; list is coverage/audit, not guaranteed error reduction.
decision: Label the top-100 for factory coverage/audit; do not expect them to be the OOD errors. Add domain-shift-aware acquisition before relying on active learning.
